items.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Stock Fair Value Rises After Guidance And AI Server Focus
items.summary: The fair value estimate for Dell Technologies has shifted from about US$502.78 to roughly US$564.46, putting a fresh spotlight on how analysts are thinking about the stock today. This change reflects close attention to Dell’s guidance and comments on component supply, memory costs, margins and the broader backdrop that includes AI server demand, macro data releases and geopolitical developments. In the sections that follow, you will see how to track these updates and make sense of the...
